name: Yes Honey
look: A simple drawing on white with empty space below. On the left, a woman with long brown hair, pink lipstick and a red turtleneck sweater smiles with her hands clasped. On the right, a gray, deeply wrinkled, exhausted-looking wojak face stares blankly.
use: The woman makes a cheerful request or demand, and the worn-out man answers "Yes honey" with no will left to argue. It jokes about always giving in to a partner, a boss or any demanding force.
slots: under the tired man: yes honey
examples: Honey, can we watch one more episode of my baking show?
Let's rearrange the living room again this weekend
